title: Translation complete subgroups of affine Weyl-Heisenberg groups and their generalized wavelet systems
summary: The $n$-dimensional affine Weyl-Heisenberg group is a Lie group typically parameterized as $G_{aWH} = \mathbb{T} \times \mathbb{R}^n \times \widehat{\mathbb{R}^n} \times \mathrm{GL}(n, \mathbb{R})$, generated by all translation, dilation, and modulation operators acting on $L^2(G)$. It was introduced by Torrésani and his coauthors as a common framework to discuss both wavelet and time-frequency analysis, as well as possible intermediate constructions.
